description_en: Sets whether the certificate feature is enabled for a domain name and updates the certificate information
description_zh: 调用SetCdnDomainSSLCertificate用于设置某域名下证书功能是否启用及更新证书信息
kebab_example: aliyun cdn set-cdn-domain-ssl-certificate --domain-name example.com --ssl-protocol off --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetCdnDomainSSLCertificate

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for which you want to configure the certificate. The domain name must use HTTPS secure acceleration. You can specify only one domain name
parameters.help_zh: 指定证书所属加速域名，需属于HTTPS加速类型。仅支持单个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the certificate. You can specify only one certificate name.
This parameter is optional when CertType is set to upload. It specifies the name of the new certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书名称，目前只支持单个证书名称。
CertType=upload时选填，给新证书的名称
parameters.name: cert_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the certificate.
This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas. It specifies the ID of an existing certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书ID。
CertType=cas时必填，表示选择已有证书
parameters.name: cert_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

upload: uploads a certificate.
cas: uses a certificate from SSL Certificates Service
parameters.help_zh:
证书类型。

upload：上传证书。
cas：证书中心证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the HTTPS certificate. Valid values:

on: enables the HTTPS certificate.
off: disables the HTTPS certificate
parameters.help_zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。

on：启用。
off：不启用
parameters.name: ssl_protocol

parameters.help_en: The content of the SSL certificate. This parameter is not required if the certificate is disabled. If you configure a certificate, you must enter the certificate content
parameters.help_zh: 安全证书内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入证书内容
parameters.name: ssl_pub

parameters.help_en: The content of the private key. This parameter is not required if the certificate is disabled. If you configure a certificate, you must enter the private key content
parameters.help_zh: 私钥内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入私钥内容
parameters.name: ssl_pri

parameters.help_en: The region where the certificate is stored. This parameter takes effect only when CertType is set to cas. Valid values: cn-hangzhou and ap-southeast-1. Default value: cn-hangzhou. International site users should use ap-southeast-1
parameters.help_zh: 证书所在地域，只有CertType=cas时生效。支持cn-hangzhou和ap-southeast-1，默认cn-hangzhou。国际站用户建议使用ap-southeast-1
parameters.name: cert_region
